text: Write the noise level as the log signal-to-noise ratio λ = log(ā / (1 − ā)).
label: core

text: A schedule is then just a way of spending timesteps along λ: the tiny model's linear schedule spends of its timesteps where noise dominates (SNR < 1 from t = 259), the cosine schedule half, SD 1.5's scaled-linear derived .
